name: Forrest Lycett
features: fair skin, thinning grey hair, light eyes, long lined face, aquiline nose, tall lean build, courteous understated expression
bio: A City tea importer who bought an 8-litre Bentley new, kept it the rest of his life, had Corsica rebody it to his own low design and made it the fastest British sports car in the world at over 140 mph. He took the very last record ever set at Brooklands, a standing mile a week before the war, then drove back to his desk in the City the same afternoon. He was president of the Vintage Sports-Car Club and died in a road accident in 1960.
